independent.summary: The new decision-log entry justifies the deliberately small 12-term vocabulary with "A workspace adds its own through `/relationship-types`", but that route cannot add a group label: POST /relationship-types reads only `{ name, sourceCategory, targetCategory }` and PUT only those three, so `scope` always falls to the schema default `'member'`. Software Architecture ships only four group labels (vs worldbuilding's ten) and a workspace has no API path to add a fifth, so the stated escape hatch does not exist for half the vocabulary.

grades.reason: The template encodes relationship types as a flat list with no group→member-role association to assert (the pairing exists only in a source comment), and the test already pins the exact ordered lists of four group labels and eight member roles, so there is no defect here — only a test-completeness preference about something the data model does not represent.

summary: The single local finding is a test-thoroughness preference about an association the data model does not encode, not a defect, and it missed the one (low-severity) inaccuracy I found in the added decision-log text.
